title: Token failure status patch must set health and Ready together
answers: repo shows Ready=True but health is unhealthy
how to surface a token failure on repository status
body: tokenFailurePatchOps (pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/controller/repository.go) always builds the /status/health patch (healthPatchIfChanged) and the /status/conditions Ready patch (buildReadyConditionWithReason with ReasonAuthenticationFailed, then BuildConditionPatchOpsFromExisting) from the same HealthStatus in one call. If only health were patched, a previously-ready repo would keep reporting Ready=True alongside the new unhealthy status. Any new status-surfacing path for a reconcile failure should reuse tokenFailurePatchOps or replicate both patches together.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/controller/repository.go, status surfacing for user-caused reconcile failures
